errors.TRANSFER_SAME_LOCATION: From and to must be two different places.
errors.TRANSFER_NOT_DRAFT: This transfer is no longer a draft. The page was refreshed.
errors.TRANSFER_EMPTY: Add at least one line before dispatch.
errors.TRANSFER_DISPATCHED: A transfer on the way cannot be cancelled; send it back with a new transfer.
errors.TRANSFER_NOT_DISPATCHED: This transfer is not on the way.
errors.TRANSFER_NEEDS_DOCUMENT: These two places have different GSTINs. A manager must record the document your CA asks for.
errors.TRANSFER_DOCUMENT_NOT_ALLOWED: Places with the same GSTIN use a delivery challan.
errors.PROMISED_ONLINE: Some units are kept for online orders. A manager can send them anyway.
errors.PIECE_NOT_HERE: This piece is not in stock here.
errors.RECEIVED_ABOVE_SENT: Received cannot be more than sent.
errors.SHORTFALL_REASON_REQUIRED: Say why each short line is short.
errors.LOCATION_HAS_TRANSFER_IN_TRANSIT: A transfer to or from this place is on the way.
errors.COUNT_ALREADY_OPEN: A count is already open at this place.
errors.COUNT_NOT_OPEN: This count is no longer open.
errors.COUNT_OUT_OF_SCOPE: This item is not part of this count.
errors.COUNT_TOO_LARGE: This count has too many lines. Count one collection at a time.
errors.RECOUNT_SAME_PERSON: A recount must be done by another person.
errors.RECOUNT_OPEN: A blind recount of this count is still open.
errors.RECOUNT_BLIND: You are doing the recount, so the first count is hidden from you.
errors.LABEL_NOT_PENDING: This label was already printed. Use Reprint.
errors.LABEL_NO_PRICE: {{sku}} has no price yet. A manager sets it first.
errors.LABELS_TOO_MANY: Too many labels at once. Print at most 500.
errors.EXPORT_TOO_LARGE: Too many rows. Narrow the dates.
errors.APPROVAL_REQUIRED: This difference needs a manager's PIN.
errors.PIN_LOCKED: This PIN is locked for a while after wrong tries.
errors.ITEM_UNTRACKED: This item's stock is not counted.
errors.LOCATION_NEEDS_GSTIN: This place is in another state and needs its own GSTIN.
errors.SERIES_NOT_CONFIGURED: No challan numbering fits this place. A manager adds it on the Transfers tab.
errors.SERIES_EXHAUSTED: This numbering has run out. A manager adds a new one.
errors.SERIES_PREFIX_IN_USE: This prefix is already used. Choose another.
errors.RECEIPT_BILLED: This receipt is billed and cannot be reversed.
errors.OPENING_COST_MISSING: Some items have no cost yet. A manager or the accountant loads item costs before opening stock is received.
errors.PROBABLY_SAVED: This was probably saved already. Refresh the page and check before trying again.
errors.uncertain: No clear answer from the server. Try again: it will not be saved twice.
errors.QTY_REQUIRED: Type the length of this item; a scan does not count measured goods.
errors.COUNT_NEEDS_RECOUNT: Some lines changed while they were being counted. Count them again or a manager accepts them.
errors.COUNT_LINE_CHANGED: This line changed after you looked. Refresh the review.
errors.COUNT_LINE_NOT_FOUND: This counted line was not found. Refresh the review.
errors.MEASURED_CONFIRM_REQUIRED: A measured item differs a lot. A manager confirms it before posting.
errors.RECOUNT_OTHER_PERSON: Only the person who started this blind recount can count or finish it.
errors.STOCK_EXISTS: Stock has moved for this item: its unit and how it is counted cannot change.
errors.TRANSFER_CHANGED: The transfer changed while it was being sent. Check it and send again.
errors.COUNT_CHANGED: Lines of this count, or the stock of items not counted, changed since it was reviewed. Check the review again before posting.

problems.decimals: Use at most {{count}} decimal places, like 2.5. Nothing is rounded.
problems.decimals_one: Use at most 1 decimal place, like 2.5. Nothing is rounded.
problems.comma: Use a dot for decimals, like 2.5.
problems.tooLarge: That is too large. Enter at most {{max}}.

warnings.QTY_ROUNDED: Some quantities are rounded to 2 decimals.
warnings.UQC_UNKNOWN: Some units are not in the GST unit list; your CA maps them.
warnings.HSN_MISSING: Some lines have no HSN code.
warnings.HSN_SHORT: Some HSN codes have fewer than 4 digits.
warnings.SCALE_UNKNOWN: The unit size of some lines could not be read; they count as whole units.
warnings.ZERO_RATE_SPLIT_UNKNOWN: 0% items are shown together as "nil or exempt"; your CA splits them.
warnings.NOT_A_TAX_INVOICE: Bills of supply are left out of the GST sheets (counted in documents).
warnings.GSTR1_DOES_NOT_ADD_UP: The GSTR-1 sheets do not add up to the bills. Do not file; tell support.
warnings.SERIES_GAP: Some numbers are missing in a series. Tell support before filing.
warnings.CANCELLED_AFTER_MONTH: A bill was cancelled after its month ended; ask your CA.
warnings.DUE_REDUCED_BY_RETURN: The due is lower because goods came back before payment.
warnings.REGISTER_DOES_NOT_ADD_UP: The register does not add up to the document totals. Tell support before filing.
warnings.HSN_DOES_NOT_ADD_UP: The HSN values do not add up to the bills minus credit notes. Tell support before filing.
warnings.NUMBER_NOT_PARSED: Some document numbers could not be read for the gap check.
warnings.REMITTANCE_HAS_NO_LOCATION: A courier remittance has no place: it is listed whole when it paid an order of your places.
warnings.SESSIONS_DO_NOT_ADD_UP: The closed sessions do not add up to their bills. Tell support.
warnings.Z_REPORT_MISSING: A closed session has no Z report; its figures are left empty.
warnings.NO_GRAND_TOTAL: A product can sit in more than one group here, so there is no grand total.
warnings.ROWS_CUT: Only the first 5,000 rows are shown. Download the file for all of them.
warnings.NO_GSTIN: Some documents have no seller GSTIN; they are listed apart and are in no GSTIN's figures.
warnings.COD_GROSS: Some courier remittances have no deductions recorded; they are shown at the full amount.

rules.sales-register: Taxable value + tax + round-off must equal the bill totals (cancelled bills left out).
rules.credit-notes: Line amounts + round-off must equal the credit note totals.
rules.hsn-summary: HSN total value + round-off must equal the bills minus the credit notes.
rules.gstr1: The sheets together must equal the bills minus the credit notes of this GSTIN and month.
rules.pos-sessions: Counter bills and paper bills of closed sessions must equal the bills of their orders.
